title: F. Edge Three-Coloring
statement:
You are given an undirected connected graph with $$n$$ vertices and $$m$$ edges, where $$m $\leq n + 9$$$.

Each edge of the graph must be colored with one of three colors numbered from $$1$$ to $$3$$. We say that vertices $$u$$ and $$v$$ are reachable in color $$c$$ if there exists a path from $$u$$ to $$v$$ consisting only of edges of color $$c$$.

Determine whether there exists a way to color the edges such that the following conditions are satisfied:

The first line contains one integer $$t$$ ($$1 $\leq t \leq 1000$$$) — the number of test cases.

Each test case begins with a line that contains two integers $$n$$ and $$m$$ ($$2 $\leq n \leq 3000$$$; $$n - 1 $\leq m \leq n + 9$$$) — the number of vertices and edges in the graph.

Each of the next $$m$$ lines of a test case contains two integers $$u_i$$ and $$v_i$$ ($$1 $\leq u_i, v_i \leq n$$$, $$u_i \ne v_i$$) — the endpoints of the $$i$$-th edge.

Additional constraints on the input:

For each test case, print the answer as follows: if such an edge coloring exists, print YES ; otherwise, print NO . Each letter may be printed in any case.

In the first example, it's possible to paint the $$5$$-th edge in color $$1$$, the $$1$$-st and the $$4$$-th edge in color $$2$$, and all other edges in color $$3$$.
input: Input The first line contains one integer $$t$$ ($$1 $\leq t \leq 1000$$$) — the number of test cases. Each test case begins with a line that contains two integers $$n$$ and $$m$$ ($$2 $\leq n \leq 3000$$$; $$n - 1 $\leq m \leq n + 9$$$) — the number of vertices and edges in the graph. Each of the next $$m$$ lines of a test case contains two integers $$u_i$$ and $$v_i$$ ($$1 $\leq u_i, v_i \leq n$$$, $$u_i \ne v_i$$) — the endpoints of the $$i$$-th edge. Additional constraints on the input: the sum of $$n$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$3000$$; in each test case, the graph has no self-loops or multiple edges; in each test case, the graph is connected.
output: Output For each test case, print the answer as follows: if such an edge coloring exists, print YES ; otherwise, print NO . Each letter may be printed in any case.
